title: Kainuu: 1.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €79,900 a year
markdown:
# Kainuu: 1.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €79,900 a year

> Closes 1.2 of 2.8 missing patients a year (42%) · €79,900 of €1M · €920,100 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kainuu, 8 are operated. In Finland it is 15. That is about 3 patients a year. [^care_surgery] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 4.3 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 1.6–6.6) [^model]. Compared with Finland as a whole, 2.8 fewer are operated and 0.0 fewer are given radiotherapy that aims to cure [^model]. In the OYS collaborative area, patients do not wait longer from diagnosis to treatment than in Finland: 31.2 days against 36.9 [^care_time_to_treatment]. In Kainuu, fewer are treated to cure: 20.8% against 27.0% [^care_curative].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 20.8% to 23.4% by 2028: 1.2 more patients a year (range 0.0–1.8), for €79,900 a year, about €68,879 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 42% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (2.8 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €11,040 | 0.3 (0.0–0.2) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.4% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €14,560 | 0.3 (0.0–0.3) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.4% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness assessment and prehabilitation before deciding against curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €13,300 | 0.1 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.1% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 0.5 (0.0–1.1) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 7.5% → 8.7% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€79,900** | **1.2 (0.0–1.8)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €227,579 a year; modelled to avoid 0.4 deaths a year (0.1–0.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 20.8% (2019–2023, measured) → 23.4% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 7.5% → 8.7% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €920,100 buys nothing more [^model]. €79,900 a year already buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure, and the limit is the reachable part of the shortfall, not money [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 41 deaths a year in Kainuu, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.2 of them [^deaths] [^model].

## Pilot ask

Pilot: Kainuu wellbeing services county + the OYS collaborative area, 6 months: (1) thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, (2) stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated. KPI: share of patients treated to cure 20.8% → 23.4% by 2028. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities: lowest to highest when all assumed effect sizes move together [^model]. No trial has measured them [^model].
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or recording [^model]. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here [^model]. A check found 0 of 3 measured outcomes matching it beyond chance [^model].

removed.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided [^model].
removed.reason: Unsupported: the source only says to look at these options to see what else the money could do. It does not say they would add more patients. Pathway measures under the deaths objective explicitly do not change who is treated to cure, and the national-decision measure is never bought from a county budget.

flagged.sentence: Fewer are treated to cure: 20.8% against 27.0% [^care_curative].
flagged.reason: Coming right after the OYS collaborative-area sentence, this read as a collaborative-area figure. The share is a county-level figure, so 'In Kainuu' was added.
This was a modelled result stated as fact, and it had no marker. Rewritten as 'In the model, ...' and [^model] added.

flagged.sentence: Effects are ranges, not probabilities: lowest to highest when all assumed effect sizes move together.
flagged.reason: Factual sentence without a marker. Added [^model], which is the obvious source (limits).

flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the model's expected share is (adjusted for the share of residents aged 65+). Rewritten as 'The expected share is adjusted...' and the missing [^model] marker was added.
